about.greeting: Hi, my name is Pedro Marques
about.bioParagraph1: I'm a Full-Stack developer passionate about creating efficient and innovative solutions. My professional journey began in Logistics, graduating from Universidade Paulista (UNIP), where I developed strong analytical and problem-solving skills. However, it was in technology that I found my true calling. I'm currently pursuing a degree in Systems Analysis and Development at UniCesumar, consolidating my theoretical foundation while actively working in the market.
about.bioParagraph2: I have solid experience in web and mobile development, using technologies such as React, Next.js, React Native, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS on the Front-End, and Node.js (NestJS, Express, Fastify) on the Back-End. I work with relational and non-relational databases, as well as modern tools from the development ecosystem.
about.bioParagraph3: Currently, my main focus is on deepening my knowledge in Back-End development and software architecture, studying Java, messaging systems, and container orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes. I've also been actively exploring the Artificial Intelligence space. My ultimate goal is to build projects that generate real value for users, while constantly evolving both technically and professionally.
